company.name: FlexCompute
company.shortDescription: FlexCompute is an IT company that specializes in providing solutions related to simulation.
company.description:
FlexCompute is an IT company that specializes in providing solutions related to simulation. It focuses on accelerating innovation with proprietary R&D solvers leveraging cutting-edge advanced computing.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

productsAndServices.description: A GPU-native computational fluid dynamics solver for simulating steady and unsteady aerodynamic flows, including aircraft, rotorcraft, vehicles, and other complex designs.
productsAndServices.name: Flow360 Solver

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based finite-difference time-domain electromagnetic simulation platform for analyzing photonic, optical, and electromagnetic devices through Python and web-based interfaces.
productsAndServices.name: Tidy3D

items.description: Flexcompute and Northrop Grumman have formed a technology partnership, integrating NVIDIA Physics NeMo to build AI physics models that automate and accelerate space mission simulation workflows by up to 100x.

sources.title: Flexcompute and GlobalFoundries Enable Integrated Design and Simulation on GF Silicon Photonics Platform

items.description: Flexcompute announced a new strategic partnership with Bramble CFD to embed its GPU-native Flow360 solver into Bramble CFD's cloud platform, creating specialized simulation workflows for motorsport and high-performance vehicle development.

sources.title: Flexcompute and Bramble CFD Partner to Deliver Best-in-Class Motorsport Simulation Workflows

sources.title: Flexcompute and Rescale Partner to Accelerate Physics AI Development with GPU-Native Simulation

items.description: Elysian Aircraft selected Flexcompute's Flow360 GPU-native CFD solver as its platform to develop the battery-electric E9X airliner, enabling faster aerodynamic design cycles.

sources.title: Elysian Selects Flexcompute's Flow360 CFD Solver for Development of Battery-Electric E9X Aircraft

items.description: Flexcompute and Robinson Helicopter Company announced a new partnership to use Flexcompute's Flow360 CFD platform in the development of the all-new Robinson R88 helicopter, aiming to accelerate design and improve performance.

sources.title: At AIAA Aviation Forum, Flexcompute and Robinson Helicopter Announce CFD Partnership for All-New R88 Helicopter

items.description: Flexcompute and Vertical Aerospace have announced a new partnership to advance the design and development of Vertical Aerospace's VX4 Electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft using Flexcompute's latest GPU-native simulation technology. The collaboration aims to accelerate aerodynamic development, reduce testing cycles, and optimize performance for electric aviation.

sources.title: Flexcompute Provides Vertical Aerospace With Latest Simulation Technology to Pioneer Electric Aviation

items.description: Flexcompute and NIO have announced a partnership to enhance aerodynamic optimization for electric vehicles using Flexcompute's Flow360 platform. This collaboration aims to improve vehicle performance and energy efficiency, setting new benchmarks in sustainable mobility.

sources.title: Flexcompute Partners With NIO To Transform Aerodynamic Optimization For Electric Vehicles
